subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the canonical fix require full paragraph-boundary semantics across in-budget and maxChars split cases, or accept a common-case text-only repair with overflow boundaries tracked separately?
rationale: Both open candidate PRs target the right shared boundary, but prior review discussion and source inspection show an exact/near-maxChars boundary decision that automation should not settle by choosing one behavior contract unilaterally.

options.title: Require full boundary semantics
options.body: Consolidate on a fix that carries boundary or seam semantics so all split cases reconstruct correctly without exceeding channel limits.

options.title: Accept common-case repair
options.body: Land one candidate for common paragraph splits and explicitly leave exact maxChars overflow behavior as follow-up on this issue or a narrower tracker.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers reject the current text-preservation direction and ask for a fresh design.

recommendation.title: Require full boundary semantics
recommendation.body: Consolidate on a fix that carries boundary or seam semantics so all split cases reconstruct correctly without exceeding channel limits.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-file blame and earlier coalescer/chunking history make this the strongest routing candidate for the boundary-semantics choice.
